llm_judge_details.justification: The topology covers core VNFs and a single gNB, but lacks edge/MEC resources for the central AI unit and does not model multiple gNBs or roadside sensor functions, so completeness is low. VNF types and slice definitions (eMBB for 4K video, URLLC for V2X) follow 3GPP standards, giving a good correctness score. Resource requests for core VNFs and UPF are modest and unlikely to sustain ~1.5‑2 Gbps of 4K streams, leading to poor resource appropriateness. Slice selection matches the use cases, earning full marks for slice alignment. SLA latency of 20 ms is higher than typical URLLC requirements (<10 ms), though throughput and availability are reasonable, resulting in a moderate SLA fitness rating.
